\begin{table}[ht]
\centering
\caption{Rule-based weights and PRISM-LR coefficients (standardised features, fitted on the full dataset). A positive coefficient raises the predicted fraud probability; the rule weights are penalties, so a negative rule weight corresponds to a positive coefficient. Account age enters PRISM-LR as a continuous feature, so its coefficient is negative (older accounts are less likely to be fraudulent).}
\label{tab:learned_weights}
